events.text: Kira: So the repair drive is still happening, right? I just want to confirm before I show up.
events.speaker: Kira

events.text: Mara: Yes, it’s still happening—please come by. I’ll keep you posted if anything changes.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming. I’ll plan to stop by, and let me know if anything changes.
events.speaker: Kira

events.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I’m here—how can I help with the repair drive?
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Mara: No worries at all—thanks for coming. Could you help sort the donated tools and set them by the tables?
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Dane: Absolutely—I can do that. I’ll sort the donated tools and get them set by the tables.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Eli: That’s the plan I’ve got: porch light at Maple and 3rd first, then the gate latch by the community garden. If anything else needs fixing, tell me in order and I’ll keep it simple.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Mara: Perfect — I’ll keep it in order and let folks know to start with the porch light at Maple and 3rd, then the garden gate latch.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Eli: Great, that sounds good to me. Keep me posted if anything else gets added, and I’ll stick to the order.

events.text: Mara: Yes, it’s still on, and we’d love to have you stop by. I’ll let you know right away if anything changes.

events.text: Quinn: Great, thanks, Mara — I’ll swing by later and see what they need. If it helps, I can also pass your update along to the neighbors I’ve already told.
